How it works

Live in days. Running itself by Friday.

No payroll migration, no new systems for your team to learn, no cost to your employees' employer brand. Three steps:

1

Connect your payroll

Link Onesto to Xero or your existing payroll in minutes. Wages data syncs securely — no spreadsheets, no manual uploads, no changes to how you run pay.

2

Invite your people

Employees, members or volunteers get a branded invitation and download the app. Custom branding carries your organisation's identity throughout.

3

Watch engagement compound

Flexible wages reconcile automatically at payday. Cashback, learning, rewards and giving run themselves — while real-time analytics show you the impact.

Plays nicely with your stack: pre-built integrations with Xero, KeyPay, Employment Hero, Tanda, Deputy, Humanforce, SAP and Sage get you running in minutes — and automated features keep monthly HR and payroll involvement to a minimum.

Questions

Everything employers ask us first

No. Flexible Wages gives employees access to pay they have already earned but not yet received. There's no credit check, no interest and no debt — the amount is simply reconciled from their next pay through your payroll. It's the ethical alternative to payday lenders and credit cards.

Onesto costs $2 per employee per month for all features — for a 2,000-person organisation that's $48,000 a year, against $560k–$1.05m in modelled annual turnover savings. Employees pay nothing for Shop to Save, Learn, Rewards or Giving; a small flat fee applies only when they choose to access wages early.

Most organisations are live within days. If you run Xero payroll, connection takes minutes via the Xero App Store. A dedicated customer success manager handles onboarding, employee invitations and launch communications with you.

Yes. Onesto was built for workforces in the broadest sense — employees, association members and volunteers. Unions, clubs, charities and community organisations use Onesto to give their people the same financial-wellbeing benefits as large employers.

Employees can donate to causes they care about straight from the app, and employers can match contributions, run campaigns and report social impact in real time. It's a benefits platform with a conscience — good for culture, good for your ESG story.

Yes. Onesto protects your information with biometric login, 256-bit encryption, bank-grade authentication and data housed locally on AWS in Australia. Employees only ever see their own information.
